title: Claim GitHub Sponsorship Fees
job_text: Log in to your GitHub account. Navigate to the sponsorship fees section. Check for pending fees and follow the claim instructions. Use the claimed funds for any necessary bills. Do not use these funds for non-essential expenses.
what_happened: a user received a message about GitHub sponsorship, claimed the fees after logging in, and used them for bills
